scripts.corpus:build: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync needleproof corpus build
scripts.corpus:ensure: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync needleproof corpus ensure
scripts.demo: pnpm corpus:ensure && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync uvicorn needleproof_api.main:app --app-dir apps/api/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=0 pnpm --filter @needleproof/web dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4321"
scripts.test: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync pytest && pnpm --filter @needleproof/web check && pnpm --filter @needleproof/web build
